        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        if (n > m) {
            int t = n;
            n = m;
            m = t;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            int x = m % 6;
            if (x <= 3) {
                System.out.println(m - x);
            } else if (x == 4) {
                System.out.println(m - 2);
            } else {
                System.out.println(m - 1);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (n <= 5 && m <= 30) {
            int[][][] answer = new int[m + 1][n + 1][1 << (3 * n)];

                for (int[] row : layer) {
                    java.util.Arrays.fill(row, -1);
                }
            }
            System.out.println(go(0, 0, 0, n, m, answer));
        } else {
            System.out.println(n * m - (n * m) % 2);
        }
    }

    private static int go(int row, int col, int mask, int n, int m, int[][][] answer) {
        if (answer[row][col][mask] != -1) {
            return answer[row][col][mask];
        }
        if (row == m) {
            return answer[row][col][mask] = (mask == 0) ? 0 : Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        }
        if (col == n) {

        }
        if ((mask & 1) == 1) {

        }
        if (col >= 2 && ((mask >> (n - 2)) & 1) == 0) {
